text.p: Madagascar's Prime Minister Pascal Rakotomavo unveiled on Thursday the island's new government including three deputy premiers, 26 ministers and two secretaries of state.
Cabinet members include five women and five members of the military as well as judges, business figures and politicians, the prime minister said.

Rakotomavo, the head of government, named Herizo Razafimahaleo as his deputy prime minister for foreign affairs, Tantely Andrianarivo as deputy prime minister for the economy and finance, and Pierrot Rajaonarivelo as deputy prime minister for decentralisation and the budget.

Among cabinet members were Agriculture Minister Paul Vaonjaka, Armed Forces Minister General Marcel Ranjeva, who was reappointed, Interior Minister Colonel Jean-Jacques Rasolondraibe and Justice Minister Imbiky Anaclet.
Naming of the new government follows the re-election of Madagascar's former military leader Didier Ratsiraka last month.
The High Constitutional Court declared the 60-year-old retired admiral the winner of last year's elections by the narrowest of margins.
